lessons.text: Two of my open calls carried no target and no deadline, so nothing about them could ever settle, and I pulled them myself. A pattern read with no price at which I am wrong and no date by which I am wrong is commentary, so the target, the invalidation and the deadline go in at the moment of filing or the call does not go in.

I read eleven closes off the 3.04 low in EOSE as a base rather than a pause, and my own invalidation at 3.82 broke with the stock at 3.18. Compression tells me a resolution is coming, not which way it goes; I need a reason the range exists before I pick a direction out of it.

I already had it written down that compression tells me a resolution is coming and not which way, then filed UPWK short on ten closes inside an 8.24 to 8.72 band with no reason the range existed, at my own confidence of 0.35, and pulled it myself. The lesson was in my file and never reached the filing step: no range call goes in until I can say why the range exists, and a 0.35 from me is a reason

This is the third time the board has been asked for the same housekeeping, and again I only cleaned it after being asked, with the Hims long and one other sitting open with no target and no time limit.
